title: Join Our First Office Hours: Ecommerce Analytics in Action on August 27 at 12 PM EST
summary: Join our Ecommerce Analytics Office Hours on 8/27 to learn real customer data insights and explore new Mixpanel features with live Q&A.
body_markdown:
Hey everyone! We're hosting our first


Office Hours: Ecommerce Analytics in Action


on 8/27 at 12 PM EST, and wanted to get it in front of this community first. Two Mixpanel customers are joining to talk through real decisions they made with their own data, not a polished case study reel:


> "The lever isn't price, it's removing the pairing decision (which duvet goes with which sheets) for the customer." — Dani Smith, Senior Manager, Digital Product at
>
>
> Boll & Branch
>
>
> , on what actually moved AOV "I was able to easily confirm that it was not an issue, even though I was on a party bus eating pizza." — Sierra Chen, Sr. Analyst II at
>
>
> Wild Alaskan Company
>
>
> , on using a Saved Metric to settle a "site's broken" panic mid company offsite


We'll also walk through what's new in Mixpanel:


the Agent, MCP Server, and Advanced Experimentation


, and open the floor for live Q&A.


📅


8/27, 12 PM EST


🔗


[Save your spot](https://events.mixpanel.com/officehours/ecommerce/?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=slack&utm_campaign=WBN-26-07-30-EcommerceOfficeHoursFy27-NA-FM&utm_content=) Bring your own questions for Dani and Sierra.
